name: list_service_backups
description: Lists the backups of a ClickHouse service, most recent first. Each backup has id, status, start and finish times, size in bytes, duration in seconds, type, and, for backups exported to a customer bucket, the backup name and bucket details. On success result has status "success" and a backups array; on failure it is an error object with status "error" and a message.

organizationId.description: Organization that owns the service. Use the id of an organization returned by get_organizations.

serviceId.description: ClickHouse service whose backups to list. Use the id of a clickhouse-type service returned by get_services_list.
